setup_powershell: .data/chinese/venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install qwen-asr==0.0.6 jieba==0.42.1 numpy==2.5.4 pytest==9.1.1
dependency_note: ffmpeg 8.0.1 is on PATH. Dedicated Python 3.12.10 environment; CPU torch 2.14.1+cpu, transformers 4.57.6, qwen-asr 0.0.6, numpy 2.5.4, jieba 0.42.1. All corpus/model artifacts are under .data/chinese. No paid service used.

asset_checksums.other_assets: Per-chunk, isolated, source WAV and source TextGrid checksums are in manifest.json and inventory.json.

verification_rationale: A correct-duration WAV and internally consistent generated JSON could still contain the wrong headset or wrong cuts. Alongside mapping/lexical-preservation/frame/separator invariants, six real 250ms output windows were compared against independent ffmpeg crops from their exact source headset and source-to-playback map. This closes the concrete wrong-audio/wrong-cut gap without a transcription study.

checks_exercised.scope: 10 deterministic regression tests and 4 actual-material smoke tests. Exact 48kHz mono PCM frames, exact two-second interchunk zeros, emitted/source checksums, immutable human lexical text in the first three transformed clips, all their word/sentence mappings, six real mapped-headset waveform windows with correlation greater than 0.98, rotating speakers, session-disjoint main/dev/20 isolated utterances.

checks_exercised.outcome: Original 3.42GiB Eval archive downloaded in 76.35s, SHA-256 computed, all archive entries enumerated, original near WAVs/TextGrids and far context TextGrids extracted. No third-party mirror used.
532 real human segments exercised; 520 raw primary alignments accepted, 12 out-of-range/reversed predictions rejected and retained as evidence. Run exited nonzero instead of filling times.

evidence_reuse_limit: Director exercised cached alignment plus build and reported 14 tests passing in 1.15s, including cached-report persistence. After the bounded integration repair, the worker observed 17 tests passing in 2.80s: unchanged real-data assertions ran against prepared local audio, while isolated temporary checkouts demonstrated four clear skips without ignored audio and preserved failures for corrupt/incomplete prepared state. The gate depends only on actual local main WAV file availability, never tracked manifest availability. Director retains final integrated acceptance.
limitations_and_unresolved_records: Verified unprompted casual proportion is conservatively zero: AliMeeting Eval is recorded discussion/meeting material. Everyday family/school and shopping topics were prioritized and tagged; they are not falsely labeled spontaneous casual chat.

Human lexical text and speaker labels are retained. Word timings are automatic estimates, not human timing verification. Main references explicitly retain 20 zero-length word estimates and 49 overlapping-adjacent-word estimates rather than inventing durations or silently deleting words.

Internal-pause counts and isolated internally-paused tags are alignment-estimated candidates, not listening-confirmed pauses. Backchannel/filler counts are disclosed text-pattern candidate counts; sentence-final particles can be pragmatically ambiguous.
Punctuation restoration appends only a terminal full stop when absent in a human source segment; these segment-based boundaries are uncertain and not a new human linguistic annotation.

No human listening/transcription-validation study was performed. The actual-material smoke uses waveform, mapping and transcript inspections, not fabricated listening claims. A short listening spot-check before benchmark freeze remains a useful Director/owner observation.

CC BY-SA 4.0 applies to adapted Chinese audio/transcripts/timelines, with attribution/change notices. Privacy/publicity/personality rights are not blanket-granted. Future publication/video adaptation still needs the applicable attribution and ShareAlike compliance; publication is not required for this revised local-preparation completion.
